chunks: There is no changing of My word, nor am I unjust to My creatures.

key_terms.الْقَوْلُ: The word, decree, or promise of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God's word is not changed and He is not unjust to His servants?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Qaf underscores the certainty of divine decree (Qadr) and the precision of God's justice, affirming that His promises are immutable and He is never unjust to His creation. It serves as a theological anchor for believers, linking the stability of divine speech with the fairness of retribution and reward, a concept deeply explored in the works of scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
